alerts.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued November 6 at 8:26PM EST by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description: The areas affected include... Buzzards Bay... Cape Cod Bay... At 825 PM EST, Doppler radar indicated a strong thunderstorm, capable of producing winds to around 30 knots. This thunderstorm was located over Wareham, or near Plymouth, moving east at 30 knots. Locations impacted include... Cape Cod Bay, The West End Of Cape Cod Canal, and The East End Of Cape Cod Canal.
alerts.instruction: Expect gusty winds to around 30 knots...briefly rough seas and lightning strikes. Consider heading for safe harbor until this storm passes.

alerts.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 6 at 7:43PM EST by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.areas: Central Middlesex County; Eastern Essex; Western Norfolk; Southeast Middlesex; Suffolk; Eastern Norfolk; Northern Bristol; Western Plymouth; Eastern Plymouth
alerts.description: At 742 PM EST, Doppler radar was tracking a thunderstorm with heavy rainfall over Dover, or near Needham, moving northeast at 25 mph. HAZARD...Heavy rain. SOURCE...Radar indicated. IMPACT...Minimal. Water on roads that flood easily. Expect ponding on flood prone road ways and travel delays. Locations impacted include... Boston, Cambridge, Brockton, Quincy, Lynn, Newton, Somerville, Framingham…
alerts.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roads or underpasses.

alerts.headline: Flood Watch issued November 6 at 2:30PM EST until November 7 at 10:00AM EST by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.areas: Northern Bristol; Western Plymouth; Eastern Plymouth; Southern Bristol; Southern Plymouth; Barnstable; Dukes; Northwest Providence; Southeast Providence; Western Kent; Eastern Kent; Bristol; Washington; Newport; Block Island
alerts.description: * WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be possible. * WHERE...Portions of southeastern Massachusetts, including the following areas, Barnstable MA, Dukes MA, Eastern Plymouth MA, Northern Bristol MA, Southern Bristol MA, Southern Plymouth MA and Western Plymouth MA and Rhode Island, including the following areas, Block Island RI, Bristol RI, Eastern Kent RI, Newport RI…
alerts.instruction: You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared to take action should flooding develop.
